mapper.insert: /* Baim02Mapper.mergeTermsInfo */ INSERT INTO TB_TERMS ( TERMS_ID , TERMS_VERSION , REQUIRED_YN , TERMS_CONTENT , STR_DATE , USE_YN , TERMS_DESC , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{termsId} , #{termsVersion} , #{requiredYn} , #{termsContent} , REPLACE(#{strDate}, '-', '') , 'Y' , #{termsDesc} , #{gvUserCd} , now() , #{gvUserCd} , now() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TERMS_VERSION = NEW.TERMS_VERSION , REQUIRED_YN = NEW.REQUIRED_YN , TERMS_CONTENT = NEW.TERMS_CONTENT , STR_DATE = NEW.STR_DATE , USE_YN = NEW.USE_YN , TERMS_DESC = NEW.TERMS_DESC , UPDATE_NO = NEW.UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
